method: Commands entered through Android UI using adb input; resulting screen read from app accessibility tree. Screen cleared before each output assertion. Owner process identity checked through the private keeper socket.
limitations: Debug APK over adb reverse, not production encrypted device transport
Monochrome 48x24 command-entry view; not full TUI or IME compatibility
No local Android model or PTY tested
No battery, thermal, long-duration, or other-device compatibility claim
